Account.summaryTitle: Nyamuneka ukosore ibi bikurikira kugira ngo ukomeze
Account.prefillNote: Winjiye nka {email}. Amakuru yawe yamaze kuzuzwa hasi.

phone.label: Numero ya telefoni
phone.hint: Numero z'u Rwanda wazandika nka 078 123 4567. Uri hanze y'igihugu, tangira na + n'kode y'igihugu cyawe.

password.label: Ijambobanga
password.hint: Nibura inyuguti 10. Amagambo make adafitanye isano arakora neza.

register.title: Fungura <accent>konti</accent>
register.intro: Konti si ngombwa. Yuzuza amakuru yawe iyo usaba urugendo kandi ikwereka ubusabe bwawe bwashize.
register.sentText: Niba iyi mimero ishobora gukoreshwa, twohereje ihuza ryo kuyemeza. Rimara amasaha 24. Reba no mu butumwa bw'ubusa niba utaribona.

login.title: <accent>Injira</accent>
login.intro: Injira kugira ngo urebe ubusabe bwawe kandi amakuru yawe yuzuzwe ubwayo.
login.guestHint: Ntukeneye konti kugira ngo usabe urugendo.
login.resetDone: Ijambobanga ryawe ryahinduwe. Ushobora kwinjira ubu.
login.resendSent: Niba iyi mimero itegereje kwemezwa, twohereje ihuza rishya.

forgot.title: Wibagiwe <accent>ijambobanga</accent>?
forgot.intro: Andika imeri yawe maze tuzakohereza ihuza ryo guhitamo ijambobanga rishya.
forgot.sentText: Niba hari konti kuri iyi mimero, twohereje ihuza ryo guhitamo ijambobanga rishya. Rimara isaha 1. Reba no mu butumwa bw'ubusa niba utaribona.

reset.title: Hitamo <accent>ijambobanga</accent> rishya
reset.intro: Andika ijambobanga rishya rya konti yawe.
reset.invalidText: Iri huza ryamaze gukoreshwa cyangwa ryararangiye. Ushobora gusaba irishya.

verify.okText: Konti yawe irarangiye. Injira kugira ngo ukomeze. Ubusabe watanze mbere ukoresheje iyi mimero bugaragara muri konti yawe.
verify.invalidText: Iri huza ryamaze gukoreshwa cyangwa ryararangiye. Niba wamaze kwemeza imeri yawe, ushobora kwinjira. Niba atari ko biri, gerageza kwinjira maze tuzaguha kohereza irishya.

requests.title: Ubusabe <accent>bwanjye</accent>
requests.intro: Ubusabe bwawe bw'urugendo bwa vuba n'aho bugeze.
requests.note: Ufite ikibazo ku busabe? Hamagara ELVAIS cyangwa umwandikire kuri WhatsApp uvuga kode y'ubusabe.

settings.title: Igenamiterere rya <accent>konti</accent>
settings.deleteText: Ibi bisiba burundu konti yawe n'ubusabe bwose bwayihujwe. Ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
settings.deleteConfirm: Yego, siba konti yanjye n'ubusabe bwanjye

errors.blocked: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Tegereza iminota 15 maze wongere ugerageze.
errors.unverified: Imeri yawe ntiremezwa. Koresha ihuza twakoherereje, cyangwa usabe irishya hasi.
errors.rateLimited: Ubusabe ni bwinshi cyane buturutse kuri interineti yawe. Tegereza gato maze wongere ugerageze.
